faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Directorate of Fisheries, Lakshadweep Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Directorate of Fisheries, Lakshadweep Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 vacancies for Paid Apprentice Trainee (Operation and Maintenance of Ice Plant).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Directorate of Fisheries, Lakshadweep Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Format of Application on page 2 of the notification PDF) and send it to Directorate of Fisheries, Kavaratti, Union Territory of Lakshadweep - 682 555, by post, to reach by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Stipend of ₹100 per day, subject to actual attendance.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: SSLC or equivalent with ITI (NCVT) in the trade of Refrigeration / Air Conditioning Mechanic.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only eligible local candidates are invited.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received after the last date are not entertained. Applications without the required supporting documents are not entertained.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection based on the marks obtained in SSLC or equivalent and ITI examinations. Marks obtained in SSLC or equivalent examination.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Training programme of 12 months (one year) for 2026-27. Training completion certificate issued on successful completion.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Kavaratti, Lakshadweep.
